Name: MiG Madness
Overview:
Outnumbered, but not outgunned!

Destroy the relentless waves of enemy MiG-15 jet aircraft, and be the Top Gun. Your weapon is the legendary North American F-86 Sabre jet. Play solo or with 1-4 player coop in this fast paced, Korean war era shooter.

Mere survival is not enough - you'll need a severe case of "MiG Madness", and hunger for crazy Power-ups to truly be the best!
